level_up_detail: the realm's blessing is on you.
gear_found: Found: {piece} - press I to wear it
ember_down: {name} is down - he will rise in {seconds}s.
ability_learned: {ability} learned — Q interrupts an enemy attack.
title_blurb: One village. One fading light. Follow the lanterns into the old wood, and bring your people home.
title_saved: YOUR JOURNEY IS SAVED AS YOU PLAY
pause_line: Your journey is saved. The road will wait.
victory_story: The ritual is broken. A light returns to the valley.
defeat_story: The ritual is complete. Keep what you learned, and try the road again.
fallen_line: Returning to your last safe lantern. The crows took {percent}% of your gold. Your progress is safe.
hud_boss_hint: Read the mark. Commit after the strike.
journal_touch_help: Push the left stick to move; push it to the rim to sprint. Drag the right half of the screen to look. Hold Strike to chain, tap Dodge to evade, and reach the arc above for Rune, Mend, Talk, Potion and Jump. Tap the Gear pill on the right edge to change weapon, armour and charm. Fire, frost and arcane weapons hit a foe's weakness for double.
journal_combat_tip: Leave the red mark before the attack lands, then strike during the recovery.
shop_sub: Stock up before you press deeper into Sundermere. Refined wares cost more each time.
gear_title: What you carry into the dark
gear_sub: Every raider and channeler leaves something behind. A fire, frost or arcane weapon strikes a foe's weakness for double - and bounces off what it resists.
gear_tip: Tap a piece and press Equip. The combat hint tells you when a swing hits a weakness.
hud_boss_enraged: Enraged. Read the mark, then commit.
